title: LINQ Fundamentals — Syntax & Lambda Expressions
description: Learn the two ways to write LINQ queries: query syntax and method syntax, plus the lambda expressions that power them.
longDescription: This module covers the fundamental syntax of LINQ. You'll learn both query syntax (SQL-like) and method syntax (fluent), and understand how lambda expressions work as the building blocks of LINQ queries.
whatYouLearn: Understand the two ways to write LINQ queries
Write queries using SQL-like query syntax
Write queries using fluent method syntax
Master lambda expressions and their role in LINQ
